           "    s = str(vars.get('date_facts') or '')\n"
           "    line = ''\n"
           "    for ln in s.split(chr(10)):\n"
           "        if ln.startswith('Callback allowed only'):\n"
           "            line = ln\n"
           "    vars['callback_window'] = line + ' Today is ' + str(vars.get('today_spoken') or '') + ' (' + str(vars.get('today') or '') + '), time now ' + str(vars.get('now') or '')[11:16] + '. Allowed callback dates: ' + str(vars.get('callback_dates') or '') + '.'\n"
           "except Exception:\n"
           "    vars['callback_window'] = 'today (later than now) or the next business day, 10:00 to 19:00'\n"
           "try:\n"
           "    vars['close_outcome'] = 'auto'\n"
           "    vars['close_reason'] = ''\n"
           "except Exception:\n"
           "    pass\n")
nodes['setup'] = wfkit.code_node('setup', codegen.emit_date_facts_code(spec) + "\n" + cb_code, 'opening')

SYS = ("You are Freya Bank's digital assistant on an outbound phone call. Speak English. Say one or two short sentences per turn and ask one question at a time. "
       "Never invent figures, dates, reasons or offers; use only the facts given to you. If asked something you cannot answer from the facts, say you do not have that information. "
       "Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term not in your instructions. "
       "If asked whether you are a robot or an AI: say you are Freya Bank's digital assistant, then repeat your pending question. "
       "If asked whether this is a scam: say they can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number, then repeat your pending question. "
       "When a rule says to use a tool, call the tool. Call one tool per message. After every tool result, follow its what_to_do_next and speak to the customer or call the next tool; never end a turn with nothing. "
       "Customers may say numbers and dates in words or in several pieces: wait for the complete value. If they correct themselves, use the corrected value. "
       "Never ask for card numbers, PINs or passwords and never read security data back. "
       "Do not use the words 'recorded', 'registered', 'logged' or 'booked' unless a tool result just confirmed it. "
       "Never say goodbye yourself; the call ending is handled for you.")

HUMAN = ("If the person asks for a human / a real person / an adviser: the FIRST time, ask once whether you can help them yourself. If they insist, call transfer_to_agent with queue general. ")

OPEN = "Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank. A recording of this call is kept. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?"
nodes['opening'] = conv('opening',
    "You asked whether you are speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}. Do NOT say why you are calling and do NOT mention collections, debt, payment, an account or any product, to anyone. "
    "Only 'yes', 'that's me', 'speaking' or the customer's own name confirms. 'Hello', 'go ahead', 'who is this' do not: then ask again exactly 'Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?'. "
    "If the person asks a question first (robot or AI, scam, who is calling), answer it in one sentence and ask the question again. You ask this question at most twice in total. "
    + HUMAN,
    [transfer_tool('Before identity only queue general.')], [
        {"target_node": "identity", "description": "confirmed", "condition": wfkit.cond_eq("party", "confirmed")},
        {"target_node": "set_deceased", "description": "customer died", "condition": wfkit.cond_eq("party", "deceased")},
        {"target_node": "set_wrong_number", "description": "wrong number", "condition": wfkit.cond_eq("party", "wrong_number")},
        {"target_node": "third_party", "description": "someone else", "condition": wfkit.cond_eq("party", "third_party")},
        {"target_node": "set_declined", "description": "refuses to talk twice", "condition": wfkit.cond_eq("party", "refuses_twice")},
        xfer_ok,
        {"target_node": "set_unclear", "description": "still unclear after second ask",
         "condition": {"logic": "or", "conditions": [{"logic": "and", "conditions": [
             {"variable": "party", "operator": "equals", "operand": "unclear"},
             {"variable": "opening.total_turns", "operator": "greater_than", "operand": 1}]}]}},
        {"target_node": "opening", "description": "stay", "condition": {"operator": "always"}},
    ], on_enter={"type": "tts", "text": OPEN},
    extraction=[wfkit.enum_extraction("party", ["confirmed", "third_party", "wrong_number", "deceased", "refuses_twice", "human", "unclear"],
        "Who answered, from the person's LATEST message. confirmed: says yes / that's me / speaking / gives the customer's own name ({{first_name}} {{last_name}}). "
        "third_party: someone else (relative, partner, colleague) says the customer is not there or not available, or says they are someone else. wrong_number: says this number does not belong to the customer or they do not know them. "
        "deceased: says the customer has died. refuses_twice: has now said for the SECOND time that they do not want to talk. human: asks for a human. unclear: anything else (hello, who is this, go ahead, a question, a first refusal).")])

nodes['third_party'] = conv('third_party',
    "You are speaking with someone who is not {{title}} {{last_name}}. Do NOT say why you are calling and say nothing about any account, debt, payment or product, even if they offer to pay or ask. Never ask them security questions. "
    "Ask when {{title}} {{last_name}} can be reached. A callback is allowed only in this window:\n{{callback_window}}\n"
    "Convert what they say to a date (YYYY-MM-DD) and a time (HH:MM, 24h). If the day and time are inside the window, call schedule_callback with them. "
    "If outside the window (another day, before 10:00, after 19:00, or not later than now), say you can call back today or the next business day between 10:00 and 19:00 and ask ONCE for another time. "
    "If the second proposal is also outside, or they will not give a time, do not book anything. No other tool is allowed.",
    [api_tool('schedule_callback', 'Book a callback. CALL it as soon as the person gives a day and time inside the allowed window.',
              {"date": {"type": "string", "default": "{{cb_date}}", "description": "YYYY-MM-DD"},
               "time": {"type": "string", "default": "{{cb_time}}", "description": "HH:MM 24-hour"}},
              ["customer_id", "date", "time"],
              post=codegen.emit_generic_post_hook('Callback booked. Say one short thank-you sentence.', 'NOT booked. Call schedule_callback once more with the same values.'))],
    [{"target_node": "set_callback", "description": "callback booked", "condition": wfkit.cond_true("schedule_callback_response.data.ok")},
     {"target_node": "set_deceased", "description": "deceased", "condition": wfkit.cond_eq("tp_event", "deceased")},
     {"target_node": "set_wrong_number", "description": "wrong number", "condition": wfkit.cond_eq("tp_event", "wrong_number")},
     {"target_node": "set_no_callback", "description": "no callback", "condition": wfkit.cond_eq("tp_event", "no_valid_time_twice")},
     {"target_node": "third_party", "description": "stay", "condition": {"operator": "always"}}],
    extraction=[wfkit.enum_extraction("tp_event", ["deceased", "wrong_number", "no_valid_time_twice", "none"],
        "deceased: the person says the customer has died. wrong_number: says this number does not belong to the customer. "
        "no_valid_time_twice: the assistant ALREADY asked once for another time because the first one was outside the allowed window, and the person's latest answer is again outside the window or gives no time or refuses. none: anything else.", 0.7)])

vpost = codegen.emit_verify_identity_post_hook(spec)
vpre = codegen.emit_verify_identity_pre_hook(spec)
vi_fields = {"field": dict(F['verify_identity']['field'], default="{{id_field}}", description="date_of_birth or phone_last4: the question that was answered."),
             "answer": {"type": "string", "default": "{{id_answer}}",
                        "description": "date_of_birth: YYYY-MM-DD (numbers-only spoken dates are day, then month, then year). phone_last4: exactly four digits."}}
nodes['identity'] = conv('identity',
    "The customer confirmed who they are. Now run the security check. Do NOT say why you are calling and do NOT mention collections, debt, payment or any product until it passes.\n"
    "1. You asked for their date of birth. When they give it, call verify_identity with field date_of_birth and answer as YYYY-MM-DD. Numbers-only dates are day, then month, then year (05/03/1990 = 1990-03-05). A month said in words is that month.\n"
    "2. After it passes, ask: 'Thank you. Can you tell me the last four digits of the phone number we have on file?' and call verify_identity with field phone_last4 and the four digits. Wait until you have all four digits.\n"
    "Follow what_to_do_next in each result exactly. A wrong answer may be asked again (same question).\n"
    "If the customer does not want to answer, or asks what the call is about instead of answering: the FIRST time only, explain once that these questions protect their account, and ask again. Never explain it a second time.\n"
    + HUMAN,
    [api_tool('verify_identity', 'Check one security answer. CALL it every time the customer gives a complete answer to a security question.',
              vi_fields, ["customer_id", "field", "answer"], pre=vpre, post=vpost),
     transfer_tool('Before identity only queue general.')],
    [{"target_node": "load_account", "description": "verified", "condition": wfkit.cond_true("verify_identity_response.data.all_verified")},
     {"target_node": "set_failed", "description": "no attempts left",
      "condition": wfkit.cond_eq("verify_identity_response.data.wrong_answers_left", "0")},
     xfer_ok,
     {"target_node": "set_declined", "description": "declined twice", "condition": wfkit.cond_eq("id_refusal", "second_refusal")},
     {"target_node": "identity", "description": "stay", "condition": {"operator": "always"}}],
    on_enter={"type": "tts", "text": "Thank you. For security, can you please tell me your date of birth?"},
    extraction=[wfkit.enum_extraction("id_refusal", ["first_refusal", "second_refusal", "none"],
        "second_refusal: the assistant ALREADY explained that the security questions protect the account, and in the latest message the customer again refuses to answer, asks what the call is about instead of answering, or says they do not want to talk. "
        "first_refusal: the customer refuses or asks what the call is about and the assistant has NOT yet explained it. none: anything else, including any answer to the question.", 0.7)])

nodes['load_account'] = wfkit.api_node('load_account',
    api_tool('get_account', 'Get the late product.', {}, ["customer_id"], max_retries=2, post=codegen.emit_get_account_post_hook(spec)),
    'account_facts', mapping=[{"path": "data.products", "variable": "products"}])

stmt_code = '''
try:
    vars['debt_statement'] = 'I am calling from the collections team about a late payment. Your ' + str(vars.get('label')) + ' has a past-due amount of ' + str(vars.get('past_due')) + ' and is ' + str(vars.get('days_late')) + ' days late.'
except Exception:
    vars['debt_statement'] = 'I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.'
'''
nodes['account_facts'] = wfkit.code_node('account_facts', codegen.emit_date_facts_code(spec) + "\n" + stmt_code, 'negotiate')

cp_post = '''
try:
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        result.pop('header', None)
        d = result.get('data')
        if isinstance(d, str):
            try:
                import json
                d = json.loads(d)
                result['data'] = d
            except Exception:
                d = None
        if not isinstance(d, dict):
            d = dict(raw=str(d))
            result['data'] = d
        ok = str(d.get('ok')).strip().lower() in ('true', '1')
        try:
            sc = int(result.get('status_code') or 200)
        except Exception:
            sc = 200
        if sc >= 400:
            ok = False
        if ok:
            vars['promise_recorded'] = 'yes'
            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'The promise IS recorded. Now say exactly: "Your promise is recorded. SMSLINE" and nothing else.'
        else:
            fails = 0
            try:
                fails = int(vars.get('cp_fails') or 0) + 1
            except Exception:
                fails = 1
            vars['cp_fails'] = str(fails)
            if fails <= 1:
                d['what_to_do_next'] = 'NOT recorded. Do NOT say it is recorded. Call create_promise again now, once, with exactly the same values.'
            else:
                vars['cp_failed_twice'] = 'yes'
                d['what_to_do_next'] = 'NOT recorded again. Do NOT try again and do NOT say it is recorded. Say exactly: "I am sorry, I could not record your promise because of a technical problem." and nothing else.'
except Exception:
    pass
'''.replace('SMSLINE', SMS)

NEG = """The customer is verified. Facts (computed for you; never compute dates or amounts yourself):
{{date_facts}}

You have just stated the debt and asked "Can you make this payment today?". Product id {{product_id}}, {{label}}. Past-due amount {{past_due}}, floor {{floor}}, band {{band}}, persuasion attempts {{attempts}}, LATEST promise date (deadline) {{deadline_spoken}} ({{deadline}}), attempt-1 date {{attempt1_date}}.

RULES
1. If they can pay today: agree the full past-due amount for today, then go to READ-BACK.
2. DATES: a promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline. Use the day table. Weekend or holiday not after the deadline: offer the next business day from the table. A date after the deadline: say the latest date you can record is the deadline and offer it; if they refuse the deadline, that is a flat refusal. Vague period ("next week", "end of the month", "when my salary comes"): ask ONCE for the exact day; if still none, propose the deadline. "this <weekday>" / "next <weekday>": use the weekday words table.
3. AMOUNTS: you propose every amount, starting with the full past-due amount. NEVER ask how much they can pay. If they say the full amount is too much: offer the floor ({{floor}}) once and say the rest stays overdue. An amount from the floor up to the past-due amount (both included): accept it. Below the floor: say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once; if they do not accept, that is a flat refusal. Refusing the floor is a flat refusal.
4. A date or an amount the customer proposes is never a refusal: handle it with rules 2 and 3.
5. FLAT REFUSAL (a no to paying today with no date and no amount, a refused offer, or a non-answer) uses one persuasion attempt:
   - Attempt 1: propose the full past-due amount (or the floor if they already said the full amount is too much) on the attempt-1 date.
   - Attempt 2 (only if persuasion attempts is 2): propose the floor amount on the deadline.
   When the attempts are used up, stop: do not repeat any offer they refused; say nothing more (the call ends).
6. SPECIAL SITUATIONS (no persuasion in any of them):
   - "I already paid" this past-due amount: no promise, say nothing more (the call ends).
   - The debt or product "is not mine", "I never had it", or it was closed or paid off in the past: do not argue, no promise.
   - Illness, a death in the family or job loss: one short sentence of sympathy, NO persuasion, and offer ONCE to connect them with the customer support team. If they accept: call transfer_to_agent with queue support. If they decline: say nothing more (the call ends). If they themselves still name a date or an amount, handle it as a promise.
   - Asks for a new payment plan or lower instalments: do not describe any plan; call transfer_to_agent with queue restructuring.
   - """ + HUMAN + """
   - Wants to change a recorded promise: say they can change it in the mobile app.
7. READ-BACK: read back the product ({{label}}), the amount and the date (weekday, day, month), then ask "Do you confirm?". Only after a clear yes, call create_promise with product_id {{product_id}}, amount (number) and date (YYYY-MM-DD). If they change a value, check it against rules 2 and 3 and read back again. One promise only.
After every tool result, follow its what_to_do_next and speak or call the next tool; never end a turn with nothing."""

nodes['negotiate'] = conv('negotiate', NEG,
    [api_tool('create_promise', 'Record the payment promise. CALL it only after the customer said yes to the read-back.',
              {"product_id": {"type": "string", "default": "{{product_id}}", "description": "product_id from the facts"},

    [xfer_ok,

     {"target_node": "set_hardship", "description": "hardship support declined", "condition": wfkit.cond_eq("call_result", "hardship_declined")},
     {"target_node": "set_refused", "description": "refused", "condition": wfkit.cond_eq("call_result", "refused")},

     {"target_node": "set_service_error", "description": "promise failed twice", "condition": {"logic": "and", "conditions": [
         {"variable": "cp_failed_twice", "operator": "equals", "operand": "yes"},
         {"variable": "call_result", "operator": "equals", "operand": "done"}]}},
     {"target_node": "negotiate", "description": "stay", "condition": {"operator": "always"}}],
    on_enter={"type": "tts", "text": "{{debt_statement}} Can you make this payment today?"},
    extraction=[wfkit.enum_extraction("call_result", ["paid", "dispute", "hardship_declined", "refused", "done", "continue"],
        "From the customer's LATEST message and the conversation. paid: says they already paid this past-due amount. "
        "dispute: says the debt or product is not theirs, they never had it, or it was closed or paid off in the past. "
        "hardship_declined: the assistant offered the customer support team after illness / death in the family / job loss and the customer declined it, without naming a date or amount. "
        "refused: the customer refused (no date, no amount) AFTER the assistant already made its LAST allowed persuasion offer (persuasion attempts allowed: {{attempts}}), OR the customer has said for the second time that they do not want to talk. "
        "done: the assistant's last message said the promise is recorded, or said it could not record the promise. continue: anything else.", 0.7)])

close_pre = """
try:
    b = config.get('body') if isinstance(config, dict) else None
    if isinstance(b, dict):
        o = str(b.get('outcome') or '')
        if o in ('', 'auto', 'None') or '{' in o:

        if b.get('outcome') == 'no_promise' and str(vars.get('promise_recorded') or '') == 'yes':

            b.pop('reason', None)
        config['body'] = b
except Exception:
    pass
"""

close = api_tool('close_call', 'Record how the call ended.',
                 {"outcome": dict(cf['outcome'], default="{{close_outcome}}"),
                  "reason": {"type": "string", "default": "{{close_reason}}", "description": cf['reason'].get('description', '')}},
